body: Dave highlighted the emotional and operational milestone that ChatGPT conversation context is no longer trapped inside individual chats because NouGenShards and NouGenRelay externalize durable memory and execution state. Preserve this as product doctrine: chats can be ephemeral intent surfaces, while important context, corrections, decisions, and work persist across providers and future sessions. The user can think out loud naturally instead of manually carrying context between models. Done when the fleet treats this as a core UX principle and architecture milestone.
